release_selection.decision: REJECTED before installation; original ledger retained
release_selection.reason: No measured C-volume wall-time benefit; scoped NORMAL/WAL connection reuse can defer last-close checkpoint until after paid send, weakening relative power-loss protection in the quiet single-connection case. Original behavior has no unconditional power-loss guarantee either.
release_selection.experimental_tests: Archived with patch and first experimental wheel in local acceptance artifacts; removed from final source because experiment was rejected.
release_selection.engine_file: Documentation/comment correction only; executable behavior unchanged.

scope: Disposable SQLite decision-ledger latency and lifecycle correction
provider: In-process FakeTransport only; zero real provider calls or paid requests
database: Disposable SQLite files created under the test/system temp directory; no authoritative database used

change.behavior: One thread-local SQLite connection per bounded decision, separate committed transactions for send intent and final receipt, synchronous close at the outer bounded exit
change.deterministic_red: The lifecycle regression expected one bounded open but the original code opened four connections in one decision; 1 failed, 2 passed before the fix
change.deterministic_green: Six lifecycle tests pass, including committed intent visibility to a separate connection, nested scope, rollback recovery, late-thread isolation, 20-scope handle cleanup, and close-error containment

uninstrumented_timeout_stress.method: DecisionEngine with a seeded disposable ledger, a 2200 ms in-process FakeTransport, one call per trial, perf_counter around decide, three trials per deadline; each final decision logged timeout and the fake received one call. Each trial waited for late answers before deleting its disposable directory.
uninstrumented_timeout_stress.limit_ms: Configured hook deadline plus 100 ms slack
uninstrumented_timeout_stress.slow_temp_volume: Inherited TEMP/TMP volume T:; disposable fixtures only
uninstrumented_timeout_stress.verdict: FAIL on inherited T: temp volume: all nine measured calls exceeded their deadline plus 100 ms slack
uninstrumented_timeout_stress.comparison_limit: Prior single T: trials did not seed the ledger, so they are not paired performance evidence. The deterministic connection-count regression proves reduced open/close churn, not a total deadline guarantee.

local_system_temp_stress.volume: Local C: system temp directory, explicitly selected instead of inherited TEMP/TMP; disposable fixtures only
local_system_temp_stress.method: Same seeded and uninstrumented DecisionEngine/FakeTransport procedure as T: trials. Original baseline loaded from git show HEAD:memorymaster/decisions/ledger.py into an isolated temporary module in a separate Python child; no shared source was edited.
local_system_temp_stress.command_shape: PowerShell here-string piped to python; for deadline in (300, 400, 1500) and trial in range(3), TemporaryDirectory(dir=LOCALAPPDATA/Temp), seed DecisionLedger, make_engine with FakeTransport(delay=2.2), perf_counter around decide_recall, wait_for_late_answers, assert/query the persisted timeout row. Baseline child first loaded git show HEAD:memorymaster/decisions/ledger.py with importlib.util.spec_from_file_location.
local_system_temp_stress.row_and_transport_checks: All 18 current/baseline trials returned a logged timeout fallback, persisted transport_outcome=timeout, and made exactly one in-process fake transport call.
local_system_temp_stress.verdict: PASS for the nine current C: trials against deadline plus 100 ms; the nine original baseline C: trials also PASS. There is no reliable end-to-end latency improvement in these measurements.
local_system_temp_stress.interpretation_limit: This is observed behavior on the local C: volume and does not establish a universal wall-clock guarantee or a production deployment result.

focused_validation.result: Low risk; changed files include concurrent coordinator-owned changes; index symbol mapping over-reports module-docstring line shifts

close_exception_regression.injected_error: sqlite3.OperationalError after closing the bounded connection
close_exception_regression.before: 1 failed: the close error escaped DecisionEngine.decide during ExitStack unwinding
close_exception_regression.after: Included in the 14 passing focused tests; decide returned its logged missing_key fallback

rejected_approaches.approach: Daemon thread per decision for final WAL close
rejected_approaches.reason: Independent review showed 20 slow closes produced 20 concurrent threads and open handles; existing breaker and invalid-score tests also intermittently returned ledger_unavailable as close/checkpoint overlapped later decisions

rejected_approaches.approach: One worker with eight-slot close queue and synchronous saturation fallback
rejected_approaches.reason: Bounded resource count but the existing breaker regression still returned ledger_unavailable due to asynchronous WAL checkpoint overlap

remaining_limit: Filesystem COMMIT and final WAL close remain synchronous and cannot be capped by SQLite lock retry deadline. C: local-temp trials met the limit while inherited T: temp trials failed; the same C: original baseline also met it. No deadline constant, test threshold, WAL durability setting, or send-intent order was weakened.
